dossier.headline: Nifty Bank sets a record 62,428 as banks lead
dossier.summary: Bank stocks have led India's rallies through November on foreign buying. On November 17 PSU lenders PNB and Canara Bank led the index to a fresh all-time high, with the Nifty Bank touching 62,428.45 intraday, above its 3 February peak of 61,764. Banks powered a second straight day of gains, and the Nifty reached a nine-month high.
why_it_matters: Banks are the largest weight in the Nifty, so their strength decides the index's direction
Foreign investors have favoured lenders in this month's buying
